defmodule Mix.Tasks.Todo.Complete do
  use Mix.Task

  @shortdoc "Complete a task"

  @impl Mix.Task
  def run([id]) do
    Mix.Task.run("app.start")

    case Integer.parse(id) do
      {task_id, ""} ->
        case TinyTasks.complete(task_id) do
          :ok -> :ok
          {:error, :not_found} -> Mix.raise("Task #{id} not found")
        end

      _ ->
        Mix.raise("Invalid task ID: #{id}")
    end
  end
end

defmodule Mix.Tasks.Todo.Complete do
  use Mix.Task

  @shortdoc "Complete a task"

  @impl Mix.Task
  def run([id]) do
    Mix.Task.run("app.start")

    case Integer.parse(id) do
      {task_id, ""} ->
        case TinyTasks.complete(task_id) do
          :ok -> :ok
          {:error, :not_found} -> Mix.raise("Task #{id} not found")
        end

      _ ->
        (
          TinyTasks.Store.write(TinyTasks.list())
          Mix.raise("Invalid task ID: #{id}")
        )
    end
  end
end
